correctness.rationale: The exact sinusoidal solution yields a positive-denominator rational signed-area formula. The polynomial degree bound is elementary; a nonstandard rigidity lemma establishes full rank because a positive-residue rational sum has strictly negative, simple interlacing numerator zeros, and an even rational ratio with only potential negative poles must be constant. This proves arbitrary prescribed-frequency realization with strictly positive perturbations. Exact rational examples (m=3,4) and 48 checker assertions/comparisons from the included standard-library checker replay passed. Finite checks are not used as an all-m proof.

value.rationale: For a natural class of hydrological common-input linear response models, the theorem gives an exact, sharp signal-complexity bound: r frequency-swept loop orientation reversals require at least r+2 distinct relaxation pathways. It also proves arbitrary positive switch frequencies are attainable without negative mixture weights, excluding an artifact of nonphysical signed mixing. This is a structural inverse diagnostic and constructive capacity classification, not merely a finite numerical instance or a routine sign check; the exact limitations on field inference are explicit.
